name: Argyle
author: Erin Carter
description: Two families of diagonal glowing tubes cross into a diamond weave, one riding brighter over the other so the lattice reads as woven luminous cord. Charge travels each diagonal and the hue shifts diamond to diamond over a softly lit ground.

params.label: Diamond size
params.effect: Size of each woven diamond in CSS pixels - a fine tight weave at the minimum, broad open lattice at the maximum.

params.label: Tube weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each glowing cord in CSS pixels, from a hairline thread to a fat neon rope.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Speed of the charge travelling the diagonals; 0 freezes the light as static beads, high sends it weaving across the frame.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around each cord; low is a crisp drawn weave, high a luminous bloom that fills the diamonds with colour.
